name: Yukinochi, Fururu! ~Tokoro ni Yori, Koi Moyou~
original_name: 雪のち、ふるるっ！～ところにより、恋もよう～
source:
Two weeks have passed since the aurora appeared in the sky. One day, Kazuki meets a girl, Fururu. She has come to this world from the fairy world to look for her father, the king of her world, and starts to live at his house until she finds him. Meanwhile, something unusual happens in the town because the fairy world seems to be losing its balance without the king. The king should be found by the end of winter, otherwise all the world will be in trouble. Kazuki and Fururu start to look for him with his friends. Will they be able to find him and save the world?

translation:
极光出现在天空中已经过去了两周。某天，和树遇到了一个名叫露露露的女孩。她从妖精世界来到这个世界，寻找她的父亲——妖精世界的国王——并开始住在和树家中，直到找到他。与此同时，由于国王不在，妖精世界似乎正在失去平衡，镇上也开始出现异常现象。必须在冬天结束前找到国王，否则整个世界都将陷入危机。和树与露露露在朋友们的帮助下开始了寻找之旅。他们能找到国王并拯救世界吗？
